protocol.scope:
Post-selection factorial diagnosis of frozen sonar scene/pose assumptions.

This is assessment only. Independent scene/truth never construct, select or
update a map. Keep the original inferred scenes, every raw pixel and both
training/unused frame partitions. No fitted geometry, pose, timing or threshold.
protocol.fitted_parameters: One common positive image gain only; no geometry/pose/time fitting
protocol.uncertainty_scope: Sensitivity to removing navigation mean error; not covariance marginalization
protocol.truth_scope: Interpolated recorded assessment pose, not exact old renderer snapshot
protocol.pairing: Same frame, raw power, ray calibration, normal convention and gain method
